description: This file is a shell script used in the TensorFlow project's CI build process, specifically for building Android components on Ubuntu 16 in the presubmit phase. It sets environment variables, runs Android build scripts, generates build configuration files, triggers Bazel builds and tests, and manages output logs.

methods.name: run_build
methods.description: Main function that sets environment variables, runs Android builds, triggers Bazel tests, and manages logs.
